op_cost.schema:
CREATE TABLE cost_record (
  tenant_id text NOT NULL,
  subject_kind text NOT NULL CHECK (subject_kind IN ('doc','query')),
  subject_id text NOT NULL,
  usd numeric(14,6) NOT NULL,
  parts jsonb NOT NULL,
  at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE VIEW cost_daily AS
  SELECT tenant_id, date_trunc('day', at) AS day, subject_kind, sum(usd) AS usd
  FROM cost_record GROUP BY 1,2,3;

op_trace.schema:
CREATE TABLE trace (
  query_id uuid NOT NULL,
  tenant_id text NOT NULL,
  day date NOT NULL,
  principal_id text NOT NULL,
  query_enc bytea NOT NULL,
  plan jsonb NOT NULL,
  candidates jsonb NOT NULL,   -- [{doc_id, source_rank, score}]
  live_calls jsonb NOT NULL,   -- [{source, status, ms, version, content_hash}]
  rerank_order text[] NOT NULL,
  index_generation text NOT NULL,
  acl_snapshot_version bigint NOT NULL,
  tool_schema_version text NOT NULL,
  model_id text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, day, query_id)
) PARTITION BY LIST (tenant_id);
op_trace.interface:
def record(trace: Trace) -> None
def replay(query_id: str, generation: str | None = None) -> ReplayResult  # same_ranking, diffs[], drift[]
